about.pageSubtitle: Boutique agency. One point of contact. Ten years of execution.
about.intro: TROIE is Hugues Lourmières' agency. Photographer, art director, AI trainer. Since 2015 I've worked with luxury houses, industrials, sports and hospitality brands — Chanel, Pantone, X-Rite, Sofitel, Heidelberg, GS Monaco, Veoria. Since 2024, I also train teams to embed AI into their daily production. TROIE brings these two worlds together: creative that gets seen, and AI that ships.
